# mv: rename a method
mv T.M T.N
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{}

func (t T) M() int { return 0 }

func F(t T) int { return t.M() }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,6 +2,6 @@

 type T struct{}

-func (t T) M() int { return 0 }
+func (t T) N() int { return 0 }

-func F(t T) int { return t.M() }
+func F(t T) int { return t.N() }
